as_told.title: Oppenheimer and Manhattan Project as original UFO secret keepers

plain: The claim is that J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the Manhattan Project (the secret US effort to build the atomic bomb during the Second World War), set up the government's secrecy around UFOs. Michels says a man he calls only Rush told him this on the record in an interview. A researcher named Bob Maguire offers it as his own belief, without naming a source: Oppenheimer and others from the Manhattan Project were, in his words, "the original secret keepers." If true, UFO secrecy would go back to the same people who kept the bomb secret, starting in the 1940s and 1950s.
